phase_policies.applies_when: At around 180 seconds, heavy economy and expansion, light production and tech, opponent posture unknown with heavy defense and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when more information about opponent composition is available.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and expansion, but begin production and army buildup; stay defensive.
phase_policies.target: Continue economy and expansion, start building up production and army, maintain defensive posture.
phase_policies.title: Early Economy Focus with Defensive Production
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-expand without army support; ensure production and scouting are not neglected.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 300 seconds, heavy economy and expansion, moderate production, light tech, opponent ground posture with heavy production and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when new opponent units are seen or if a tech switch is detected.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and production, strengthen ground army, maintain expansion, watch for pressure.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and production, strengthen ground army, maintain expansion, keep an eye on potential pressure.
phase_policies.title: Ground Development with Tech and Economy Expansion
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect scouting or army production while teching; avoid blind tech without information.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 480 seconds, heavy economy, production, and expansion, moderate tech, opponent ground posture with heavy production and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if air units or a tech switch are seen.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground army, continue economy and tech, maintain defense.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground army, continue developing economy and tech, maintain defense.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army Strengthening with Tech and Economy
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to ground without anti-air if opponent shows air units; avoid neglecting defense.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 600 seconds, heavy economy, production, and expansion, heavy tech, opponent ground posture with heavy production and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if air units or a tech switch are seen.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain economy, production, tech, strengthen ground army, keep defense.
phase_policies.target: Maintain economy, production, and tech, continue strengthening ground army, keep defense.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army Consolidation with Tech and Economy
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air if opponent transitions to air; avoid overcommitting to ground without scouting.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
